Description: roof replacement comp for comp

Complete tear-off of 1 layer of existing asphalt shingles (approx. 1,400 sq. ft.) on a single-family residence (R-3). Inspection of existing plywood deck with replacement of up to 150 sq. ft. of damaged wood as needed. Installation of GAF Tiger Paw synthetic underlayment and GAF WeatherWatch ice and water barrier in valleys. Installation of new Class A fire-rated GAF HDZ shingles. Work includes new 2x2” pre-painted drip edge at eaves/rakes, new chimney bonderized saddle flashing (cricket), and new galvanized plumbing/aluminum vent flashing. Provide positive attic airflow with new vents per current building code.
